_readme: scripts/check-block-baselines.mjs (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE section 7.3). A rise is refused; a fall is written down with --update --reason. Provenance rules are check-adoption's. `patterns` is the manifest and is part of the basis.

entries.description: Independent block systems still in the tree (target 2 since ADR-1955: the entity-block registry and the website builder's Puck blocks). Counted as how many of the system entry points from the EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE section 2.1 table exist: entity blocks, Puck-shaped, Space profile, Spotlight. Layout modules (lib/widgets/modules.ts) is the page Apps catalog, not a block system (ADR-1955).

frozen.reason: Layout modules reclassified by owner ruling (ADR-1955, Daniel 2026-11-16 17:26Z): lib/widgets/modules.ts is the page Apps catalog, a registered menu catalog, not a block system, so it leaves the manifest. No file moved. Two systems remain: the entity-block registry and the website builder's Puck blocks, which is the E2 target (ADR-1955).

history.reason: Manifest re-seeded to the five systems in the EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE section 2.1 table (owner approval, Daniel, 2026-11-16, ADR-1953). Out: lib/email-studio/product-block.ts (send-time data binding for a block already in the registry), lib/library/element-catalog.ts (the Loom art catalog), components/spotlight (a directory that cannot disappear). In: lib/widgets/modules.ts, lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts, lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts. The count reads 5 before and after; nothing was consolidated.

Space profile sections folded into the entity-block registry (PROG-E2B): lib/spaces/profile-blocks.ts is deleted and its fourteen sections are now derived from ENTITY_BLOCKS in lib/entity-blocks/space-profile.ts. Rendered output and stored layouts unchanged (goldens). Four systems remain: entity blocks, Puck, layout modules, Spotlight.

Spotlight block kit folded beside the entity-block registry (PROG-E2C): lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts is now lib/entity-blocks/spotlight.ts, and each of its nine types is held to a registry row a member may hold (goldens). Stored layouts, validation and rendered output unchanged. Three systems remain: entity blocks, Puck, layout modules.

Layout modules reclassified by owner ruling (ADR-1955, Daniel 2026-11-16 17:26Z): lib/widgets/modules.ts is the page Apps catalog, a registered menu catalog, not a block system, so it leaves the manifest. No file moved. Two systems remain: the entity-block registry and the website builder's Puck blocks, which is the E2 target (ADR-1955).
